fields.label: Description
fields.value: Three-panel brochure on purple paper for a Studio Museum in Harlem exhibition, "Eleven from California: Selected West Coast Black Artists from California". Photograph reproduction of sculpture on cover, with text on interior including an exhibition description, artist statements, and a catalogue listing. The exhibition featured Los Angeles-based artists that had exhibited at Brockman Gallery. Both Alonzo Davis and Dale Brockman Davis are thanked for their roles in organizing the exhibition. The Studio Museum in Harlem was founded in 1968 and focuses largely on the works of the African diaspora.
